name: platformio-esp32
description: PlatformIO project for ESP32 (Arduino framework): blink + serial. Build/upload with pio.

files.content:
[env:esp32dev]
platform = espressif32
board = esp32dev
framework = arduino
monitor_speed = 115200
; lib_deps =
;   knolleary/PubSubClient

# PlatformIO ESP32

Install PlatformIO (`pip install platformio` or the VS Code extension).

- Build: `pio run`
- Upload: `pio run -t upload`
- Monitor: `pio device monitor -b 115200`

Change `board` in platformio.ini for other targets: `nanoatmega328` (Uno/Nano), `nodemcuv2` (ESP8266), `pico` (RP2040), `nucleo_f411re` (STM32). Add libraries under `lib_deps`.
